title: Coffee Shop Social Media Marketing: Build Your Following | Bellwether Coffee

facts.fact: The page recommends about 30 minutes per day of time investment for Instagram as a coffee shop platform.
facts.quote: | Instagram | Visual brand, local discovery | All ages, broad reach | 30 min/day |

facts.fact: The page recommends about 1 hour per day of time investment for TikTok, with a primary audience of ages 18–34.
facts.quote: | TikTok | Growth, younger audience | 18–34 primarily | 1 hour/day |

facts.fact: The page recommends about 15 minutes per day for Facebook, whose audience it describes as skewing 30+ and older.
facts.quote: | Facebook | Local community, events | 30+ skewing older | 15 min/day |

facts.fact: The page recommends about 5 minutes per day for Google Business.
facts.quote: | Google Business | Local search, reviews | Anyone searching | 5 min/day |

facts.fact: The page sets a goal engagement rate of 3–6% on Instagram as its own benchmark, not a third-party figure.
facts.quote: | Engagement rate | Content resonance | 3–6% on Instagram |
